Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and neutropenia with monocytosis and basophilia, suggesting possible bone marrow or immune dysregulation. Elevated ferritin and INR may indicate inflammation and altered coagulation. Erythrocytosis is present but hemoglobin and hematocrit are within normal limits. Other parameters, including renal, liver, and cardiac markers, are unremarkable. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
